run_budget.overlap_model: producer pacing and consumer fixed work overlap; critical path is max

parameters.frame_interval_note: The device-clock frame interval is a harness parameter; Stage 1 does not claim the real acquisition rate.

producer_write.reason: The producer and consumer call get_timestamp_32b() on different cores. The source has no same-designated-core producer stamp without changing the pacing kernel, so producer-versus-consumer attribution remains open.

clock_source_evidence.cross_core_note: intervals use only the designated consumer core; cross-core correlation is out of scope

startup.clock: designated consumer RISCV_DEBUG_REG_WALL_CLOCK_L; 32-bit low word, software-extended (wrap-tracked)

histogram.sample_definition: Intervals between consumer completion timestamps; the first frame is excluded and dropped producer attempts are excluded.

ring.synchronization: ring pointers and control metadata only

power_clock_provenance.sha256_definition: SHA-256 of the complete immutable per-run power CSV snapshot bytes

outlier_analysis.method: short < 1250000 ticks, long > 1450000 ticks, adjacent pair sum within 1000 ticks of 2700000

table_swap.switch_interval_definition: previous completion to first consumed frame in schedule segment
table_swap.pre_switch_interval_definition: previous completion to last processed frame before scheduled switch

issue119_measurement.status: not timing evidence (coverage incomplete, discard counts valid)
issue119_measurement.owner_approval: Four original rows and one additional prefetch measurement; no further board run.

raw_runner_record.publication_changes: Only this derived issue119_measurement block is added. Every original runner field and original run-bound snapshot reference is retained.

issue119_measurement.snapshot_naming_note: Original run-bound snapshot basename retained for strict positive-duration validation; same-stem power companion duplicates its frozen bytes.

strict_record_expected_failures: power trace coverage_complete is not true
validation.checksum_note: Production harness verified every downloaded checksum row before recording. Board-free revalidation compares its persisted digest with every expected frame/identity/checksum; raw checksum rows and raw summary words are not separately retained by this unmodified production runner.

steady_interval.steady_definition: Completion intervals excluding endpoints from switch-1 through first-ready-frame+1, inclusive; no exclusion in control.

comparison_to_same_session_control.definition: This row minus same-session control; one accepted observation per condition, no significance claim. Non-timing rows are descriptive only.

issue119_measurement.power_semantics: Left-held ASIC power_w samples over captured host program UTC interval; not board power or whole-host power.
issue119_measurement.coverage_follow_up: Issue #157; separate PR, original evidence unchanged.
